title: Matteo Manente
text:
I am a Licensed Psychologist and PhD Candidate in Psychological Sciences at the University of Padova, where I am a member of the Psicostat research group.
I am currently a Visiting PhD Student at the Department of Data Science, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (Harvard Medical School) in Boston, working under the supervision of Prof. Giovanni Parmigiani.
My research combines clinical psychology and statistical methodology, with a focus on improving the robustness, transparency, and replicability of psychological research.
In particular, I develop and apply inferential methods for Multiverse Meta-Analysis, including PIMMA (Post-selection Inference in Multiverse Meta-Analysis), to investigate how analytical decisions affect statistical inference and scientific conclusions.
